content_sections.heading: About the Society
content_sections.text: Shri Shivaji Mofat Education Society, Kandhar, Dist. Nanded, runs three institutions named in the notice: Shri Shivaji College of Arts, Commerce & Science, Kandhar; Shri Sant Gadge Maharaj Mahavidyalaya, Loha, Tq. Loha; and Shri Shivaji Law College, Kandhar. The notice names Hon'ble Dr. Keshavraoji Dhondge Saheb (Veteran Freedom Fighter, Ex. M.P. and M.L.A.) as founder and administrator. This is a recruitment by a private education society for posts on 100% granted basis.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 27 Assistant Professor posts across 13 subjects. The posts are permitted as per NOC No. JDHE Nanded / NOC / 2026 / 00023 dated 28/10/2026. The notice does not say which subject belongs to which of the three institutions. The notice prints one reservation break-up for all 27 posts together, including parallel reservation posts, not subject by subject. Persons with disability: 2 posts in total, for (A) Blindness and Low Vision and (B) Deaf and Hard of Hearing. The notice also states that, according to Govt. rules, 30% and 4% of seats are reserved for women and differently abled persons respectively.

tables.caption: Category-wise Reservation (Horizontal Reservation as per NOC 28-10-2026)

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification for Assistant Professor is as per the UGC Regulations (2018) and the Government of Maharashtra G.R. dated 8 March 2019, 10 May 2019, 5 March 2024, 31 August 2026 and 6 November 2026. The notice prints one qualification for all subjects and does not state any experience requirement. Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme before 11 July 2009 are governed by the provisions of the awarding institution and are exempted from NET/SET, subject to all these conditions: The fulfilment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the concerned University. NET/SET is also not required for Master's disciplines in which NET/SET is not conducted; in such disciplines a Ph.D. degree remains the minimum eligibility. At least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) at Master's level is the essential qualification for direct recruitment. A 5% relaxation at Bachelor's and Master's level is allowed for SC, ST, OBC (Non-creamy Layer) and differently abled candidates (Blindness and low vision; Deaf and Hard of Hearing; Locomotor disability; Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; Multiple disabilities), based only on qualifying marks without any grace marks. A 5% relaxation (from 55% to 50%) applies to Ph.D. holders who obtained their Master's Degree before 19 September 1991. A grade regarded as equivalent to 55% at Master's level, where a recognised university follows grading, is also valid. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: A: Master's Degree in the relevant subject with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognised university, and NET (UGC/CSIR) or a similar UGC-accredited test such as SET, or a Ph.D. under the UGC Regulations, 2009 or 2016. OR B: Ph.D. from a foreign university or institution ranked among the top 500 in the QS, THE or ARWU (Shanghai) World University Ranking.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay scale is given from time to time as per the rules of UGC, the State Government of Maharashtra and Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded. The notice prints no pay amount. The posts are to be filled on 100% granted basis. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes shortlisting on academic scores followed by an interview. Shortlisting: academic scores as specified in Appendix II (Table 3A for universities, Table 3B for colleges) are considered only for shortlisting candidates for the interview. The appendices are not reproduced in the notice. Interview: selection is based only on performance in the interview. The notice gives no interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed form. All attested Xerox copies of certificates and other relevant documents.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The vacancies of Assistant Professors will be filled subject to the decision in Writ Petition No.12051/2015 pending in the High Court of Bombay, Bench at Aurangabad. Reserved category candidates must send one copy of the application to the Special Cell of the University, Nanded; the notice names this officer as Assistant Registrar in the main text and Assistant Dy. Registrar in Note 7. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates already in service must apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor posts are there in Shri Shivaji Mofat Education Society recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 27 Assistant Professor posts in 13 subjects, to be filled on 100% granted basis in the Society's colleges at Kandhar and Loha, Nanded.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted within fifteen days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The notice does not print the publication date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree in the relevant subject with at least 55% marks from a recognised university, plus NET/SET or a Ph.D. under UGC Regulations, 2009 or 2016; or a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500 of QS, THE or ARWU.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the prescribed form, available at www.srtmun.ac.in, with attested copies of certificates by email to [email protected], by Registered Post or in person.

faq.question: Q5. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Academic scores per Appendix II (Table 3A for universities, Table 3B for colleges) are used only to shortlist candidates for the interview. Selection is based only on interview performance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of Assistant Professor in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay scale is given as per the rules of UGC, the State Government of Maharashtra and Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded. The notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q7. Do reserved category candidates need to send an extra copy of the application?
faq.answer: Yes. Reserved category candidates must send one copy of the application to the Assistant Registrar (Special Cell), Swami Ramanand Teerth Marathwada University, Nanded, by Registered Post.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Can employed candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible candidates already in service must submit their applications through proper channel.

faq.question: Q10. Are posts reserved for women and disabled candidates?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states 30% and 4% of seats are reserved for women and differently abled persons respectively; the table shows 7 posts for women and 2 posts for persons with disability.
